stories.title: Senedd election 2026: Polling stations open at 7am in Flintshire
stories.summary: Polling stations across Flintshire open at 7am today, Thursday 7 May, for the 2026 Senedd election. Voting will close at 10pm. Flintshire voters are split between two of the 16 new Senedd constituencies: Fflint Wrecsam and Clwyd. Fflint Wrecsam covers most of Deeside and the eastern parts of Flintshire alongside Wrexham. stories.title: Coleg Cambria wins Connah’s Quay pitch appeal as planning inspector overturns Flintshire refusal
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria has won its appeal against Flintshire County Council’s refusal of planning permission for an all-weather football pitch at its Deeside campus on Kelsterton Road, Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Flintshire schools and teachers urged to enter Chester Zoo’s National Education Awards
stories.summary: Chester Zoo is calling for nominations from Flintshire, Wrexham and Denbighshire schools and teachers for its National Education Awards, with entries open until 17 May. stories.title: Planning inspectors press Uniper on flood and CO2 plans for new Connah’s Quay power station
stories.summary: Planning inspectors examining Uniper UK’s proposed Connah’s Quay Low Carbon Power Project have issued a second round of written questions on flood risk, sewage, accidental CO2 release and saltmarsh.
